title: lulynx 残差 LoRA 模式

standard.summary: 残差 shortcut 的合并模式：下列可选值说明含换档影响。基于 ResLoRA (arXiv:2402.18039)，本仓另加：按运行时 adapter 调用顺序解析 shortcut 图（上游要显式 Transformer block 契约），并按 (in,out) 形状分残差链。
standard.effect: 不同枚举会改变算法目标、资源占用或导出兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 先默认，再按显存/质量/兼容目标换档。
standard.avoidWhen: 未做短测对照前不要同时叠多个激进实验档。

optionDescriptions.block_shortcut: block 之间抄近路，梯度好穿，导出要注意拓扑。
optionDescriptions.input_shortcut: 从输入侧短路，浅层信息留得多。

standard_en.summary: How the residual shortcut is combined: the values below include what changing gear does. Based on ResLoRA (arXiv:2402.18039), with this repository adding: the shortcut graph is resolved from the runtime adapter call order (upstream requires an explicit Transformer block contract), and the residual chains are split by (in,out) shape.
standard_en.effect: Different enum values change the algorithm's target, its resource use, or export compatibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start on the default, then change gear according to your VRAM, quality or compatibility goal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive experimental gears before running a short controlled test.

optionDescriptions.block_shortcut: Takes a shortcut between blocks: gradients pass through well, but mind the topology on export.
optionDescriptions.input_shortcut: Shortcuts from the input side, keeping more shallow-layer information.
